desc: This first wild ride that blends energetic electric guitars with traditional mariachi elements is continuation of "Pistolero Guitars" by Mark Del Castillo, lead guitarist of Mexican-American rock band "Chingón" (formed filmmaker Robert Rodriguez).

tracks.desc: This fast-paced, TEX-MEX INSTRUMENTAL ROCK track opens with a massive guitar and bass riff set to a blasting drum set beat. The middle part is driven by Spanish nylon string guitars with a half-time feel. Rockabilly and raw, twangy surf vibes throughout. Blistering, high-energy fusion of traditional mariachi, ranchera, and spaghetti western soundtracks with gritty, amplified Texas garage rock. Great for car chases, action scenes, road trips, crime thrillers and drama.

This mid-tempo INSTRUMENTAL CUMBIA features a traditional topline first presented as an electric guitar chord melody, then replied by a trumpet and clarinet for more local color. Timbales, bells and percussion keep the mood pleasant. Regional marking: Mexico. Great for travel footage, culinary features, cooking shows, tourism and family dramas.

This TEX-MEX INSTRUMENTAL ROCK track starts at a low dynamic, then builds with fast-paced rockabilly licks and raw, twangy surf vibes throughout. Moody and energetic fusion of traditional mariachi, ranchera, and spaghetti western soundtracks with gritty, amplified Texas garage rock. Great for car chases, action scenes, road trips, crime thrillers and drama.

Cinematic and dark LATIN INSTRUMENTAL UNDERSCORE mid-tempo track that features nylon string guitars and orchestral sound design layered against a backdrop of Afro-Cuban percussion phrasings. Great for scenes of intrigue, tension and suspense in crime thrillers, narco dramas and film-noir.

Cinematic and dark TEX-MEX INSTRUMENTAL ROCK mid-tempo track that features surging electric guitar leads and nylon string flourishes layered against a backdrop of orchestral sound design. The soaring extended outro lead screams for action sequences. Great for scenes of intrigue, tension and suspense in crime thrillers, narco dramas and film-noir.
